learning_outcomes.text: Learns the stages of Pilates exercises.
Explain the basic concepts of Pilates exercises.
Explains the application principles of Pilates support materials.
Uses materials related to Pilates exercise practices.
Implements Pilates exercises at a basic level.

syllabus_topics: Information about the aim, content and functioning of the course, historical development of Pilates, definition, classification and teaching of basic concepts and basic principles specific to the Pilates branch
Introduction to Pilates studies, Pilates preparation exercises
Application studies of Pilates preparation exercises
Application studies of basic level Pilates exercises
Application of basic level Pilates mat exercises
Pilates mat pelvic floor exercises and application studies
Pilates mat lower extremity exercises and leg exercises application studies
Pilates mat upper extremity exercises and application studies
Application of basic and intermediate level Pilates mat exercises
Application studies of basic level Pilates ball exercises
Application studies of basic level Pilates thera band exercises
Application studies of basic level Pilates hoop exercises
Basic level supported material usage course studies
bibliography: Pilates Topu, Pilates Matı, Pilates Thera Bandı, Pilates Çemberi Taylor Alpers, A., Taylor Segel R. ve Gentry, L. (2009). Her Yönüyle Pilates. Arkadaş Yayıncılık, Ankara.
academic_year: vigente en el Bologna Bilgi Sistemi (Yeni)
